    About this model

    MyFarmTwin uses a simplified, fictional dairy-farming model for learning and gameplay. Feed, water, milk yield, storage, prices, and time progression are not advice for actual farming or safe milk handling. Raw milk in this game is sold to a processor, not offered for direct consumption.

    This game scenario keeps adult cows in active lactation. Real lactation is finite and follows calving; reproduction and dry-period transitions are not simulated.

    No account. Just you, a little land, and a fresh start.
